facts.text: Rock House is on the north coast of Providenciales on a 14-acre oceanfront site.
facts.excerpt: located on the north coast of Providenciales upon a majestic 14-acre oceanfront site

facts.text: Rock House sits on a limestone cliff with elevations up to 95 feet above sea level.
facts.excerpt: Rock House is the only resort on the island nestled into a limestone cliff with elevations up to 95 feet above sea level.

facts.text: Rock House is less than 10 minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: Less than 10 minutes from the airport, paradise awaits.

facts.text: Rock House is in a residential neighborhood called Blue Mountain, away from the densely touristed areas.
facts.excerpt: Rock House is off this main drag in a residential neighborhood called Blue Mountain, the highest point on the island. It is away from the densely touristed areas

facts.text: Rock House's design draws on the Amalfi coast.
facts.excerpt: from its white cliff setting and Amalfi-inspired design to the intimate spaces and secluded beach

facts.text: Local craftsmen chiseled the natural limestone into the resort's walls and walkways.
facts.excerpt: The dominant architectural feature is the natural limestone, which local craftsmen have chiseled into walls and walkways.

facts.text: Rock House was inspired by the cliffside Hotel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, where the founder's wife conducted interviews.
facts.excerpt: Often, she conducted celebrity interviews at the Hotel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, a distinguished cliffside hotel famous for its elegance. A seed was planted.

facts.text: Rock House received a 2026 MICHELIN Key.
facts.excerpt: Rock House has been recognized with a **2026 MICHELIN Key**

facts.text: Rock House has earned Green Key certification for sustainable tourism.
facts.excerpt: Earning the **Green Key certification**, an internationally recognized standard for sustainable tourism, is a reflection of that commitment.

facts.text: The resort's private beach sits at the base of a limestone cliff, with a jetty extending into the protected waters of the North Shore.
facts.excerpt: Boasting over 350 ft of private beachfront at the base of our rugged 25 ft. limestone cliff, the beach at Rock House offers its jetty, extending 100 ft in to the protected waters of Providenciales’ North Shore

facts.text: The beach lies along the third-largest barrier reef in the world, so guests can snorkel right from the shore.
facts.excerpt: The resort has 350 feet of beachfront, along the third-largest barrier reef in the world, so it’s possible to snorkel right from the shore.

facts.text: Snorkeling gear, see-through paddle boards and kayaks are complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Snorkeling gear is complimentary, as is the use of the see-through paddle boards and kayaks

facts.text: Vita restaurant serves traditional Italian dishes with Caribbean influence.
facts.excerpt: indulging in fine wines and traditional Italian dishes with Caribbean influence

facts.text: Vita is perched over 30 feet above the sea.
facts.excerpt: perched over 30 feet above the sea

facts.text: Cave Bar features natural rock walls and handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: This intimate bar features the natural rock walls and creative design that make it a truly unique experience. Our menu features a variety of handcrafted cocktails

facts.text: The Spa at Rock House uses OSEA marine botanicals and Manucurist Paris nail care.
facts.excerpt: Our focused menu of signature facials and massages draws on mineral-rich marine botanicals from OSEA and clean nail care from Manucurist Paris.

facts.text: The spa has two double treatment rooms and a private pool terrace.
facts.excerpt: opening out to a private pool terrace with sofa seating, and a sun lounger. Two double treatment rooms complete the space

facts.text: Once a week, a complimentary evening of gentle yoga, sound bath and stargazing is offered.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary, once a week, an evening of gentle yoga, sound bath, and stargazing, closing with a sleep tea.

facts.text: The Ocean View Ten Bedroom Reserve Villa is created by combining two adjacent five-bedroom Reserve Villas.
facts.excerpt: Created by combining two adjacent Ocean View Five Bedroom Reserve Villas, the Ocean View Ten Bedroom Reserve Villa

facts.text: Suites, duplexes and studios have their own terraces with ocean views and 13-foot vaulted ceilings.
facts.excerpt: have their own terraces with intoxicating ocean views and feature 13-foot vaulted ceilings

facts.text: Rock House runs a weekly guided Nature Trail tour.
facts.excerpt: Embark on the Rock House Nature Trail Tour and explore paradise like never before.

facts.text: There are no special activities for young children.
facts.excerpt: there are no special activities for the wee ones

facts.text: There are currently no ADA standards for accessible design in place.
facts.excerpt: There are currently no ADA standards for Accessible Design in place.
